description_en:
General-purpose backfill API that supports both list-mode and bulk-mode backfill:
1. Backfill instances will be generated and executed, affecting the data output of related tables.
2. Task execution will incur computing costs and storage costs
description_zh:
通用补数据接口，支持列表模式补数据和海量模式补数据：
1.会生成补数据实例运行，影响相关表数据产出。
2.会进行任务运行，造成计算的费用以及存储的费用
kebab_example: aliyun dataphin-public create-node-supplement --op-tenant-id 30001011 --create-command '{"MinDueTime":"00:00","ProjectId":101121,"DownStreamNodeIdList":[{"Id":"2323232","FieldIdList":["232322211"]}],"ContainAllDownStream":false,"FilterList":[{"Exclude":false,"ValueList":["xxtest"],"Key":"NODE_OUTPUT_NAME"}],"MaxDueTime":"20:59","GlobalParamList":[{"Value":"value1","Key":"param1"}],"EndBizDate":"2024-05-21","Name":"xx测试","StartBizDate":"2024-05-21","NodeIdList":[{"Id":"n_1232324","FieldIdList":["1201"]}],"Parallelism":1,"NodeParamsList":[{"NodeId":"n_23324","ParamList":[{"Value":"value1","Key":"param1"}]}]}' --env PROD --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateNodeSupplement
